description: Parse a raw email (.eml / RFC 5322 + MIME) for triage: decoded headers (RFC 2047), addresses, Received hop chain with relays, IPs, timestamps and delays, originating IP, Authentication-Results (SPF / DKIM / DMARC / ARC), DKIM-Signature domains and selectors, MIME part tree, attachments (name, type, size, SHA-256, risky extensions), text body and links (with anchor-text vs href domain mismatch). Adds phishing / spoofing indicators (From vs Return-Path / Reply-To misalignment, display-name spoofing, brand impersonation, auth failures, urgency language) and a 0-100 risk score. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/email-parse
